description:
A repository cleanup is required. We currently have a 'Generic' repository named 'temp-uploads' containing Maven artifacts that were uploaded manually. These need to be moved to a proper Maven repository to be usable by build tools.

Your task:
1. Create a new Local Repository with the Package Type 'Maven' and the Repository Key 'libs-commons-local'.
2. Move all artifacts from the 'temp-uploads' repository (specifically the 'org' folder and its contents) into the new 'libs-commons-local' repository.
3. Once the artifacts are successfully moved and verified, delete the old 'temp-uploads' repository.

Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 with default admin credentials (admin / password).
